name: Ukugawula kwe-router
job.name: Ukugawula
intro: Gawula izinkombandlela ze-V, ugxathe imigqa, noma ugawule isithombe njengesikhala esiphakanyisiwe, bese uhlola uhlelo bese uluthumela ku-router yakho. Indawo yokuqala: qala ngokuhamba ngomoya ukuze uhlole uhlelo ngomshini wakho.
host.none: Lolu hlelo alunawo umdwebo wokufunda izimo kuwo.
mode.vcarve.note: Izimo ezivaliwe (izinhlamvu, amalogo): i-V-bit ilandela phakathi kwesimo ngasinye, ijule njengoba ibanzi, ukuze izindonga zihlangane nomphetho ngokunembile. Izimbobo yizimo ezisemkhatsini wezinye izimo.
mode.engrave.note: Landela imigqa nemiphetho ngokujula, ngokudlula kanye noma ngaphezu kwesisodwa. Umugqa we-V-bit ubanzi njengoba ujule.
mode.relief.note: Isithombe esimnyama nesimhlophe siba yisithombe esiphakanyisiwe esingu-3D: okumhlophe kuhlala phezulu, okumnyama kugawulwa kujule ngokugcwele. Umgawuli ulandela indawo ngaphandle kokungena kuyo.
post.note: Umbhalo umshini wakho owudingayo ozungeze ukusika. {rpm} {tool} {name} {safe} {feed} {unit} ziyagcwaliswa. Izinguquko zakho ziyagcinwa lolu hlobo.
cad.draw.label: Dweba izindlela zokugawula
cad.erase.label: Susa izindlela zokugawula
r.flatyes: ububanzi obudlula {d} mm: isisekelo silinganile, ubude bayo {z} mm
r.flatno: akukho: yonke ingxenye incane ngokwanele ye-V-bit kuphela
r.cellv: {p} mm ngepikseli yesithombe, {step} mm phakathi kwemigqa.
carve.warn.floor: Isisekelo esilinganile sishiyiwe: khetha i-flat mill noma i-V-bit ukuze siqedwe.
carve.warn.narrowfloor: Isisekelo esilinganile sincane kuno-flat mill: i-V-bit iyasitrima, kodwa akukho okuhlanzwa kuqala.
preview.alt: Ibhlokhi njengoba izindlela zamathuluzi zizoyigawula, imnyama kakhulu lapho ijule khona
preview.note: Ukubuka kuqala kwebhlokhi egawuliwe, imnyama lapho ijule khona (ikhombisa isimo se-cutter, hhayi umshini).
check.nofeed: Inyathelo lokusika lifika ngaphambi kokusethwa kwesivinini sokugawula.
check.nospindle: Ukusika kwehla ngaphansi kwephezulu ngenkathi i-spindle ingakaqali.
check.rapidcut: Inyathelo lokuhamba ngokushesha liwela ngaphansi kwephezulu lomsebenzi.
check.nounit: Uhlelo alusho ukuthi imilimitha noma amayintshi.
check.note: Ukuhlola kufunda i-G-code emuva bese kufuna lokho okungabhidliza noma okungachitha umsebenzi. Akwazi umshini wakho: qala ngokuhamba ngomoya ukuze uhlole.
carve.err.noshape: Ayikho isimo esivaliwe sokugawula. Dweba noma khetha imiphetho evaliwe.
carve.err.manypasses: Ukuhlanza isisekelo nge-V-bit kungathatha ukudlula okungaphezu kwenani lokuthi: {count}. Sebenzisa i-flat mill, noma shiya isisekelo.
carve.err.big: Isimo sikhulu kakhulu kulolu caca. Gawula sibe yizingxenye.
cmd.carve.help: Yenza izindlela zokugawula kusukela ezimweni ngezilungiselelo zephaneli.
cmd.carvedraw.help: Yenza izindlela zokugawula bese uzidweba komdwebo.
cmd.carvegcode.help: Yenza izindlela zokugawula bese ulanda i-G-code.
cmd.gcode.done: I-G-code ilandiwe: imisebenzi {ops}, imigqa {lines}, cishe {minutes} min.
